title: AI Flow Focus Faded—But the AI Rotation Is Just Getting Started
author: KumoPaper
selftext:
[We all watched the AI narrative pivot hard this week: Nvidia took the headlines over leadership noise, ](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004523789?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)but cash never bailed on the AI trade—money rotated into AMD, Broadcom, cloud infrastructure and the rest of the AI buildout stack instead. Even as CPI came in hot and yields stayed elevated, the mega-cap tech recovery held, just uneven.  

The tape isn’t flashing a full market-wide rush right now—broad participation still hasn’t showed up, and the real test lands with Nvidia’s upcoming earnings and Jensen Huang’s Capitol Hill briefing next week. Semis have sponsorship to catch up on price, but that narrow breadth still leaves the current rebound vulnerable. Anyone else spotting that selective AI repositioning play out across their watchlist?

comments.author: Stunning_Room7648
comments.body: Where's the rotation most obvious on your watchlist, cloud infrastructure or semis? I'd like to know if this money is betting on earnings or on policy.
